title: PM Koretskyi orders faster repairs to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge
summary: The Cabinet of Ministers has instructed the Ministry for Recovery, Infrastructure and Transport to speed up repairs to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge, which was damaged in a Russian missile attack overnight on October 27.

title: Soldier who held position alone for 491 days nominated for Hero of Ukraine title
summary: The Verkhovna Rada supported an appeal to the President to award the title of Hero of Ukraine to serviceman Kostiantyn Vlasenko, who held a combat position in the Kupiansk sector for 491 days and was evacuated after suffering severe injuries during a unique aerial evacuation operation.

title: Azov fighter sentenced to 29 years by Russia returns from captivity
summary: As a result of the prisoner exchange on October 23, Azov soldier Taras Zvarychuk returned from Russian captivity; the occupiers had sentenced him to 29 years in prison “for terrorism.”

title: Russian airstrike on Sloviansk city center injures one person
summary: On the evening of October 27, Russian troops carried out an airstrike on the center of Sloviansk; a woman was injured, and a school building was destroyed.

title: Zelensky: Ukraine receives average of just 12 Patriot missiles per month this year
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that this year, Ukraine is receiving an average of only 12 missiles per month for its Patriot systems.

title: War update: Over 190 clashes on front lines in past day, most Russian attacks on Pokrovsk axis
summary: A total of 191 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on October 27.

title: Air defenses neutralize 71 Russian drones overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces have neutralized 71 Russian drones since the evening of October 27.

title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,510 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 28, 2026, have reached approximately 1,583,350 personnel, including 1,510 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia region 846 times over past 24 hours, two injured
summary: Russian troops launched 846 attacks on 41 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours. Two people were injured in enemy attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district.

title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to five
summary: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district has risen to five, including a child.

title: 'Cognitive erosion' has become a new target of disinformation – expert
summary: The strategy behind modern disinformation operations has undergone significant changes. With the development of artificial intelligence technologies, hostile actors are increasingly abandoning attempts to persuade audiences of anything in favor of what is known as "cognitive erosion."

title: Norway extradites banker suspected of stealing over UAH 1M from customers' accounts to Ukraine
summary: A former bank employee from Ukraine's Ternopil region, suspected of misappropriating customers' funds and wanted internationally, has been extradited from Norway to Ukraine.

title: Fire reported at steelworks in Russia's Lipetsk after attack – social media
summary: The Russian city of Lipetsk was targeted by jet-powered projectiles, and a fire reportedly broke out near the Novolipetsk steel mill (NLMK), according to preliminary information.

title: Kyiv to allocate UAH 1 bn for water crossings over the Dnipro, Klitschko says
summary: Additional technical solutions are being developed to preserve the structural integrity of bridges across the Dnipro River amid attacks on critical infrastructure in the capital.

title: Norway allocates nearly $54M in energy support for Ukraine
summary: The Norwegian government announced on Tuesday, October 27, that it would provide 500 million kroner (nearly $54 million) in energy support for Ukraine ahead of winter.

title: Ukrposhta cuts network to 7,211 branches over three years, Lubinets says
summary: Dmytro Lubinets, the Verkhovna Rada Commissioner for Human Rights, announced a reduction in the Ukrposhta network from 10,000 to 7,211 branches and provided the company with recommendations on tracking mobile branches and ensuring citizens’ access to postal services.
